description: Test whether a URL may be crawled under its site's robots.txt by Googlebot, Bingbot and every AI crawler MakerRadar tracks (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended …), with the group and the exact rule that decides each, plus the file's Sitemap lines, Content Signals, Crawl-delay and the lines crawlers skip. It fetches only robots.txt and stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The URL to test (https://…): its path is checked against its site's robots.txt.

name: test_robots_txt

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Test a URL against robots.txt
